steps.name: vesperd_starts
steps.detail: vesperd listening on run/vesperd-suite/main.sock (backend systemvm, microVM vesper-vesperd, Firecracker 1.16.0 pid 3227) (mode 600) after 1672 ms; guest: RUNNING vesper-vesperd pid=3227 holder=2991

steps.name: second_vesperd_on_socket_refused
steps.detail: exit Some(1): vesperd failed: another vesperd holds run/vesperd-suite/main.sock.lock; no microVM launched

steps.name: boot_through_vesperd
steps.detail: PUT /machine-config (1 vCPU, 256 MiB), PUT /boot-source, PUT /actions InstanceStart -> 204 on one connection; InstanceStart took 26 ms

steps.name: guest_boots
steps.detail: the guest init printed VESPER-MICROVM-OK on the serial console

steps.name: snapshot_create_under_ceiling
steps.detail: PUT /snapshot/create (Full, 256 MiB guest, jail on the data disk) -> 204 in 1285 ms; ceiling 120 s

steps.name: firecracker_connection_limit_passes_through
steps.detail: 10 connections open; the next got Firecracker's own 503 byte for byte; after closing them a new one works

steps.name: idle_timeout_closes_only_vesperd_connections
steps.detail: vesperd closed an idle connection after 119995 ms with no bytes; a direct FCAPI connection idle for 125 s still answered GET / 200

steps.name: same_id_refused
steps.detail: refused after 15456 ms: vesperd failed: LAUNCHAPI vesper-vesperd: ERR busy vesper-vesperd after 15 s; another microVM holds the id; the first still answers GET / (Running)

steps.name: sigterm_stops_microvm
steps.detail: exit 0 after 60 ms; socket removed; ABSENT vesper-vesperd 3 ms later (jail, cgroup, record and process gone)

steps.name: sigkill_removes_microvm
steps.detail: SIGKILL to vesperd; ABSENT vesper-vesperd-kill after 516 ms; stale socket file left: true (removed)

steps.name: firecracker_killed_vesperd_exits
steps.detail: KILLED-FC vesper-vesperd-fcexit pid=5215; vesperd exited Some(1) after 964 ms: vesperd failed: the lease of microVM vesper-vesperd-fcexit closed: Firecracker exited or the System VM went away; ABSENT 5 ms later

steps.name: tap_devices_in_own_netns
steps.detail: PUT /network-interfaces eth0 (tap0) and eth1 (tap1) -> 204, and eth0 (tap0) on a concurrent second microVM -> 204; eth2 (tap9, not given) -> 400 "{\"fault_message\":\"Network config error: Could not create the network device: Ope"; PUT /mmds/config, InstanceStart -> 204; LINK lo state=UP owner=-, LINK tap0 state=UP owner=20000, LINK tap1 state=UP owner=20000, NETNS vesper-vesperd-net separate=true ino=4026532170; netns_ok on both; namespaces distinct; SIGTERM: ABSENT vesper-vesperd-net and vesper-vesperd-net2 3 ms later; net vesper-vesperd-net: ERR no network namespace for vesper-vesperd-net

steps.name: nothing_left
steps.detail: no lease or jail for vesper-vesperd, vesper-vesperd-kill, vesper-vesperd-fcexit, vesper-vesperd-net, vesper-vesperd-net2; no socket in run/vesperd-suite
